meta.title: Prevent double-building of Microsoft.DotNet.Cli.Utils.csproj by excluding PublishDir from global properties
meta.body_summary: Add GlobalPropertiesToRemove="PublishDir" to ProjectReferences across multiple projects to prevent double-build of Microsoft.DotNet.Cli.Utils.csproj and avoid PDB mismatches.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot initially applied fix in GenerateLayout.targets; after maintainer correction, moved to ProjectReferences; merged with approval.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 8273 changed lines (much due to merge), the meaningful build-optimization change is small (~52 additions, ~42 deletions across .csproj files). This fits a targeted incremental build fix that merged after iterative review despite large merge noise.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer marcpopMSFT corrected the initial implementation location from GenerateLayout.targets to ProjectReferences, requiring Copilot to adjust scope and add property removal to all ProjectReferences in identified projects.
review_details.performance_claim: Prevent double-build of CLI.Utils.csproj to eliminate redundant build work and avoid PDB mismatches.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Understanding MSBuild property propagation and correct placement of GlobalPropertiesToRemove required precise maintainer guidance; agent iterated successfully but needed explicit correction.

detection_detail.code_reading: marcpopMSFT reviewed the proposed changes and provided step-by-step correction through PR comments.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or before/after build comparison; fix relies on understanding of property propagation.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Fix was adjusted within the PR before merge; no revert or follow-up needed.

core_change_summary.description: Added GlobalPropertiesToRemove="PublishDir" to ProjectReference elements in multiple .csproj files (CLI, Containers, Resolvers) to stop PublishDir from propagating and causing double-build of Microsoft.DotNet.Cli.Utils.csproj.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Merge of upstream/main introduced numerous unrelated documentation and build infrastructure changes; the performance fix itself is limited to the .csproj modifications.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added GlobalPropertiesToRemove to MSBuild tasks in GenerateLayout.targets (commit de8ced6).
After maintainer feedback, moved property removal to ProjectReferences of identified projects instead, removing from targets (commit 1cba47).
Expanded GlobalPropertiesToRemove to all ProjectReferences in those projects, not just the ones referencing CLI.Utils (commit 40a7ae).
Merge commit resolved conflicts with main branch.

review_signals.summary: Copilot bot posted PR Overview summarizing changes; reviewed 7/7 files with no inline comments.
APPROVED with comment acknowledging reduction of overbuild and alignment with prior discussion.
Corrected initial approach: instead of adding to MSBuild calls in GenerateLayout.targets, add GlobalPropertiesToRemove to ProjectReferences of projects called by those targets.
Requested to apply GlobalPropertiesToRemove to all ProjectReferences in the edited .csproj files, not just those for CLI.Utils.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot expanded the change to all ProjectReferences.

review_signals.summary: Confirmed implementation of design correction and scope expansion in subsequent commits.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with first attempt in GenerateLayout.targets.
Maintainer quickly corrected to modify ProjectReferences instead.
Copilot reimplemented and further expanded coverage per feedback.
After a long period (likely waiting for merge), maintainer approved and merged.
